s: Today we talk about days and dates.
And we learn five new words.
Age means how old you are.
To fly means to travel in an aircraft, in a plane.
Last May I flew to Paris.
And we will fly to Paris next week!
When you fly, you look at the date.
Dates are important when you fly.
Second means coming after the first.
Monday is the first day of the week.
The second of May is a date.
The second of June is a date.
The second day, the second date!
About means on the subject of.
Maya, what about your Friday plans?
And that is word five: action film.
An action film is a film with lots of exciting events.
I love watching action films with my friends.
An action film on Friday night is the best!
Now let us use all five words.

About Monday, about Friday, about fun plans!
And we talk about action films!
